hooks.command: echo 'Persona publishing reminder: run .claude/hooks/public-repo-guard.sh --check-staged at the CI/release seam; this runtime hook is advisory only.' >&2; exit 0

SessionStart.command: if [ -f .persona-cloud-repository ]; then .claude/hooks/public-repo-guard.sh --cloud-preflight || exit $?; context='Cloud: private GitHub visibility was proven before this context loads.'; else context='Local persona session: no GitHub visibility claim is made.'; fi; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"%s Read user/profile.md and user/memory/MEMORY.md before relying on personal context. If the profile is unfilled, interview one section at a time and confirm each section before writing. Report any role-critical capability gap before claiming complete coverage."}}\n' "$context"

Stop.prompt: Before ending: reflect on whether anything meaningful happened this session (decisions, corrections, discoveries, preferences). Native auto-memory handles persistence automatically — do NOT manually create or edit files in user/memory/. Just ensure important insights surface in your thinking so auto-memory captures them. Skip if nothing worth remembering occurred. Separately: did anything cross the durability bar this session — a decision, a learning, a source worth keeping? If yes, propose routing it through the vault:curator agent — the single vault front door (don't silent-write; surface for approval). Auto-memory and vault ingest are different surfaces with different audiences.

PreCompact.prompt: Context is about to be compacted. Reflect on any important session context that should be preserved — decisions, discoveries, user preferences, corrections. Native auto-memory handles persistence automatically. Do NOT manually create or edit files in user/memory/. Separately: did anything cross the durability bar this session — a decision, a learning, a source worth keeping? If yes, propose routing it through the vault:curator agent — the single vault front door (don't silent-write; surface for approval). Auto-memory and vault ingest are different surfaces with different audiences.

PostCompact.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostCompact","additionalContext":"Context was just compacted. Check user/memory/.last-crash — if it exists, a previous session ended unexpectedly. Read it, offer to review what was lost, then delete the marker."}}'
